title: nbisweden/grave pipeline parameters
description: A workflow for mapping and variant calling aDNA against pangenome graphs

steps.description: The workflow steps to execute, provided as a csv string

reference.description: Path to reference .gbz graph (modes: unfiltered_graph, filtered_graph), or .fasta (mode: linear)

reference_type.description: The type of reference file provided, changes the run mode accordingly

multi_reference_graphs.title: Multi-reference graphs
multi_reference_graphs.description: Set when the graph contains multiple reference samples

multiple_references.description: Run graph analyses assuming multiple reference assemblies

project.description: Provide this when using a SLURM system (project allocation code for hours logging)

freebayes.description: Turn on (true) or off (false) the Freebayes variant caller

deepvariant.description: Turn on (true) or off (false) the DeepVariant variant caller

reference_stats.description: Report reference statistics (FAI index for linear, text summaries for graphs)

keepRawGam.description: Publish raw GAM files in addition to standard filtered outputs

keepRawVcf.description: Publish raw VCF files in addition to standard filtered & normalised output

discardUnmerged.description: When merging aDNA reads, discard unmerged. If false, unmerged reads are combined with merged in a single FASTQ

fastpDedup.description: Remove duplicate reads detected by exact hash matching algorithm

dupCalcAccuracy.description: Accuracy of the duplication rate calculation. Higher accuracy uses more memory to avoid hash collision (1: 1G, 2: 2G, 3: 4G, 4: 8G, 5: 16G, 6: 24G). If --fastpDedup = true, 3+ recommended. If false, 1 recommended

readDiscardLength.description: Discard reads shorter than this value

minFastpOverlapLength.description: Minimum overlap required for FASTP to merge paired-end data

aDNAkmerLength.description: K value when K-mer profiling ancient DNA samples and constructing graph indexes

aDNAwindowLength.description: Window size when constructing graph indexes for ancient DNA samples

modernKmerLength.description: K value when K-mer profiling modern samples and constructing graph indexes

modernWindowLength.description: Window size when constructing graph indexes for modern samples

noNestedDistance.description: For complex graphs 'dist' index may use excessive memory. Set 'true' to debug (produces a limited version of the index and reduces memory imprint)

aDNA_mismatch_penalty.description: Giraffe alignment (aDNA reads only): mismatch penalty

aDNA_gap_open_penalty.description: Giraffe alignment (aDNA reads only): gap open penalty

aDNA_gap_extend_penalty.description: Giraffe alignment (aDNA reads only): gap extend penalty

kffKmerMinimum.description: FASTQ: Minimum required occurences of a read K-mer for it to be counted prior to haplotype subsampling

gamDiscardUnmapped.description: GAM: Discard unmapped reads when filtering

minimumMapQFilter.description: GAM: MAPQ threshold applied when filtering (< INT), requires --gamFilterMapQ

alignIdentityFilter.description: GAM: Apply alignment fraction identity filtering

minimumScorePrimaryAlign.description: GAM: Fraction identity required to keep primary alignment during filtering, requires --alignIdentityFilter

gamDefrayEnds.description: GAM: Clip the ends of ambiguously aligned reads

defrayEndsLength.description: GAM: When clipping, sets max number of bases to clip from read ends, requires --gamDefrayEnds

dedupConsiderBothEnds.description: For aDNA, consider both the 5' and 3' ends of the read when identifying duplicates. When false, the 5' end is used

removeDuplicates.description: Remove duplicate reads with Picard MarkDuplicates. If false, they are written with duplicate flags and the tagging policy is applied

duplicateTaggingPolicy.description: Policy for tagging duplicates in the DT optional SAM/BAM field

samplePloidy.description: General: Ploidy of the study organism

minimumAlleleSupport.description: General: Minimum allele support for a call

maxNestLevel.description: Genotyping: Maximum variant nest level. Discards VCF variants over this 'nest' level from genotyping outputs, unless found in a popped feature, i.e., reference allele was over --maxRefLength. Does not affect raw VCF output

maxRefLength.description: Genotyping: Maximum reference allele size. Pops/discards VCF variants if the reference allele is over this value, retaining variants nested within the popped variant (even if they are nested above --maxNestLevel). Does not affect raw VCF output

minimumSiteSupport.description: Genotyping: Minimum site support for a call

baselineErrorSmallVariants.description: Genotyping: Baseline error rates for Poisson model for small variants

baselineErrorLargeVariants.description: Genotyping: Baseline error rates for Poisson model for large variants

freebayes_mode.description: FreeBayes: run in normal mode (single-threaded), or parallel mode (experimental)

maxComplexGap.description: FreeBayes: Maximum distance between polymorphisms on the same read

minFraction.description: FreeBayes: Require at least this fraction of observations supporting an alternate allele within a single individual in the in order to evaluate the position

deepVariantModelType.description: Deepvariant: The model to use, based on the read data type

version.description: Print the workflow version and exit

tracing.description: Output workflow execution reports (resource/timeline reports and DAG image)
